module_summary: Differential source-synchronous DDR input: target-specific differential buffers convert clock and data pairs to single-ended, then an ssio_ddr_in child captures data on both edges into two SDR outputs.

anchors.name: input_d_p
anchors.why: Positive leg of differential DDR data input, buffered into input_d.

anchors.name: output_q1
anchors.why: SDR data captured on the first clock edge by the DDR input child.

anchors.name: output_q2
anchors.why: SDR data captured on the second clock edge by the DDR input child.

anchors.name: output_clk
anchors.why: Buffered received clock output from the child, clocking the captured data.

anchors.name: input_d
anchors.why: Single-ended DDR data after differential buffer, fed to the DDR capture child.

anchors.name: input_clk
anchors.why: Single-ended received clock after differential buffer, fed to the child.

groups.name: diff_input_buffers
groups.description: IBUFDS/ALT_INBUF_DIFF or direct assigns converting differential clock and data to single-ended.

groups.name: ddr_capture
groups.description: DDR input child buffers the clock and splits DDR data into two SDR words.
